title: Principal Scientist - Firefly Enterprise
description:
**Principal Scientist:** Firefly Enterprise India
  
  

The Opportunity
  
Firefly Enterprise brings Adobe's generative AI and creative technology into the heart of enterprise content production by helping large organizations create, adapt, and deliver on\-brand content at production scale, inside the tools their teams already use.
  
  

**Our charter spans two areas:**  

**Audio/Video Solutions:** The media\-processing backbone for enterprise\-scale content production: ingesting, transforming, generating, and delivering audio and video reliably at production volume.
  
**Extensibility:** Enterprise agentic workflows and plug\-ins that surface Firefly's enterprise capabilities directly inside Figma and other Adobe creative applications.
  
We're looking for a Principal Scientist to be the technical anchor of a small, fast\-growing team; a player\-coach who is as comfortable in the architecture and the codebase as in a design review or a customer conversation.
  
This is a senior individual\-contributor role. You won't carry direct reports or own headcount, but you will set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and mentor a team of software and machine\-learning engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering managers on people leadership, and you'll be instrumental in interviewing and holding the hiring bar high.
  
Impact You'll Make
  
Set the long\-term technical architecture and vision across both charter areas.
  
Make enterprise\-scale reliability and resiliency a first\-class property of everything the team ships.
  
Bring AI capabilities into the product and into how the team builds, raising both customer value and engineering velocity.
  
Grow a scaling team of software and machine\-learning engineers through hands\-on work and mentorship, i.e., lifting the technical bar by example.
  
Turn customer and field insight into a credible, deliverable roadmap in partnership with adjacent teams.
  
What You'll Do
  
Own the architecture for enterprise\-scale audio/video media\-processing pipelines by designing for throughput, latency, cost, and operational resilience at production volume.
  
**Architect the extensibility platform :** agentic enterprise workflows and plug\-ins that expose Firefly's enterprise capabilities inside Figma and other Adobe creative apps.
  
Stay hands\-on by writing code, leading design and architecture reviews, and setting the engineering standards the team builds to.
  
Mentor developers and specialists in machine learning alike, growing their technical judgment through the work.
  
**Play an instrumental role in hiring:** interview, calibrate, and keep the bar high.
  
Interface directly with customers and field/sales teams to identify real problems and collaborate across adjacent teams to shape the roadmap and deliver solutions.
  
Manage collaborators and expectations across engineering, product, and the field; with clarity and follow\-through.
  
Leverage AI capabilities to improve both what customers get and how the team develops software.
  
What You'll Bring
  
15\+ years building large\-scale distributed software systems.
  
Proven experience operating at enterprise scale with a deep focus on reliability and resiliency .
  
Strong backend engineering in Java, Python, or comparable technologies, with a solid command of distributed systems and cloud\-native platforms.
  
Experience with at least one of the team's two domains, and the ability to ramp on the other:
  
**Media processing:** audio/video pipelines, transcoding, streaming, or large\-scale media workflows.
  
**Extensibility:** SDKs, plug\-in architectures, integration frameworks, or agentic systems.
  
A track record of mentoring both software engineers and machine\-learning engineers and raising the technical bar across a team.
  
Comfort working directly with customers and field/sales teams to translate problems into solutions.
  
Strong collaborator management with the ability to set expectations and align across engineering, product, and the field.
  
Excellent communication and the ability to make complex architecture legible to engineers, product leaders, and executives.
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience employing AI capabilities for both customer\-facing value and internal product development.
  
Familiarity with LLM application architectures, RAG, AI orchestration frameworks, MCP, or agentic systems.
  
Experience building integrations or plug\-ins for Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, or comparable creative ecosystems.
  
Depth in enterprise\-scale media processing, namely, codecs, streaming infrastructure, or GPU\-accelerated media pipelines.
  
Familiarity with enterprise identity, security, governance, and compliance frameworks.
  
Contributions to open\-source software or widely adopted developer platforms.
  
  

About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  

Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**  

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience .

title: AI Solution Architect II
description:
AI Solution Architect II
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


As an AI Architect, you will guide the strategy and delivery for interoperable, compliant, and economically viable modern AI solutions. You will architectures across a Hybrid AI landscape, blending Frontier Models (Azure OpenAI/Gemini) with Cost\-Efficient Small Language Models (SLMs) and Edge Inference. You will craft solutions based on advanced AI technologies from OpenAI, NVIDIA, Google, , Microsoft and AWS. This role has a focus on enabling advanced Agentic AI solutions that transform core business functions and enable the future hybrid workforce. Working at the highest levels, you will engage AI, Technology and Business leaders in the world’s most successful organizations. You will lead architectural design, establish best practices, for our most complex AI initiatives. This role requires a combination of deep hands\-on technical expertise in advanced AI with strategic business acumen, serving as both a technical authority and a trusted advisor to clients


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


What you’ll do Multi\-Agent Architecture Patterns: Define and govern reference architecture for multi\-agent systems, covering hierarchical, peer\-to\-peer, and sequential (ReAct) orchestration models. Guide teams on pattern selection based on client use cases. Memory System Design: Architect the standards for integrated memory systems, including short\-term session state, long\-term knowledge via vector databases and knowledge graphs, and episodic/audit memory. Ensure coherent retrieval strategies across layers. Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and CAG (Cache Augmented) Architecture: Define architectural patterns for end\-to\-end RAG pipelines, including chunking, embedding, vector search (e.g., Azure Cognitive Search, pgvector), and reranking. Ensure designs include standards for lineage, observability, and evaluation (e.g., RAGAS). Cross\-Cloud \& Vendor Integration: Create and maintain decision frameworks for platform selection (e.g., Copilot Studio for Teams integration, Vertex AI for GCP workloads). Advise clients on balancing vendor lock\-in risks with integration benefits. GenAIOps \& Observability: Define the architectural standards for GenAIOps, including CI/CD, IaC, and observability. Establish standard metrics to track agent decision traces, latency, token consumption, hallucination, and cost. Safety, Security \& Governance: Architect enterprise\-wide guardrails for safety (hallucination mitigation), security (prompt injection defense, PII masking), and fairness (bias detection). Apply governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001\) and design human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) workflows. Enterprise Integration \& Scalability: Architect scalable integration patterns for agentic systems with enterprise platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Teams, Dynamics/Salesforce, ERPs) and compute (Kubernetes). Ensure patterns address security, data residency, and compliance. 1 Technical Leadership \& Client Advisory: Combine technical architecture with strategic guidance. Lead C\-level workshops on Agentic AI adoption, advise on roadmaps, and shape technology strategy. Mentor other architects and contribute to industry thought leadership. Thought leadership and public speaking: Present at industry events and publish articles that advance the AI industry. Core Qualifications (The Bar) •Enterprise Experience: 8–10\+ years in technical leadership, with a strong background in both software engineering and enterprise\-scale cloud architecture. •Cloud Expertise: Architectural expertise with one primary cloud platform (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and hands\-on familiarity with at least one other. •GenAI \& LLM Depth: Demonstrated experience architecting and guiding solutions using GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or AWS Bedrock). •RAG \& Orchestration: Proven experience designing complex RAG pipelines. •Model Fine\-tuning: Experience with instruction tuning or fine\-tuning strategies for LLMs. •Leadership \& Advisory Skills: Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated experience advising senior stakeholders (Director/C\-Level) on technical strategy, roadmaps, and governance.


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


Preferred Qualifications (The Differentiators) • Multi\-Agent Systems: Deep understanding of, and experience designing or prototyping, advanced multi\-agent systems (e.g., task decomposition, collaborative agents). • Multi\-Cloud Experience: hands\-on architectural expertise across all three major clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP). • GenAI Ops \& Governance: Hands\-on experience with GenAI Ops tooling. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001\) and their practical application. And AI FinOps \& Model Routing • Framework Expertise: Hands\-on development experience with one or more orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel). • Thought Leadership \& Open Source: Published work (whitepapers, patents), conference speaking engagements, or active contributions to relevant open\-source projects. • Certifications: Professional\-level cloud certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, GCP Professional Cloud Architect).


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


Soft Skills \& Behavioural Competencies We are looking for professionals who combine deep technical expertise with strong interpersonal and leadership abilities. Specifically: • Clear, Multi\-Level Communication • Strategic Thinking \& Advisory Mindset • Cross\-Functional \& Cross\-Vendor Collaboration • Pragmatic Problem\-Solving • Ownership \& Accountability • Continuous Learning \& Adaptability • Customer Obsession \& Trust\-Building • Leadership \& Mentorship • Change Agent Mindset

title: Design Verification - Technical Leader
description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross\-functional teams.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems.
* Architect and review UVM\-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects.
* Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle.
* Lead protocol\-level verification efforts (e.g., I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug.
* Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e.g., JasperGold) to complement simulation\-based verification, particularly for FSM and control\-logic\-heavy blocks.
* Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches.
* Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design\-for\-verification practices.
* Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable.
* Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp\-up on tools, methodology, and protocols.
* Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse.
* Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders.
* Support root\-cause analysis of silicon/post\-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred).
* 5\-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem.
* Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology — testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models.
* Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion\-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification.
* Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools.
* Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e.g., JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control\-logic verification.
* Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA,MIPI\-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP\-based verification.
* Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management.
* Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers.
* Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage\-quality assessment techniques.
* Familiarity with low\-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations.
* Experience working with EDA vendors (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution.
* Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development.
* Experience working in a globally distributed team environment.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability.
* Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under\-specified requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present technical status and risk clearly to management.
* Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines.
* Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross\-functional teams.
* Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency.

**What We Offer**

* A technical leadership track with visibility into IP\-level and subsystem\-level verification strategy.
* Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices.
* Mentorship and people\-development opportunities within a growing team.
* Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next\-generation Security IP and systems.
* Collaborative, cross\-functional work environment with global teams.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.  



  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Middleware Manager
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Manager, Middleware Services team is responsible for leading the strategy, engineering, operations, automation, security, and modernization of enterprise middleware and container platforms. This role manages a team of engineers responsible for delivering highly available, secure, and scalable platform services that support critical business applications across traditional infrastructure and AWS cloud environments.  

  

The successful candidate will balance people leadership, platform ownership, operational excellence, and technology modernization while partnering with application teams, architecture, infrastructure, security, and cloud engineering organizations. The role is expected to drive adoption of cloud\-native technologies, automation, self\-service capabilities, and engineering best practices that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Ownership \& Strategy**

* Own the enterprise middleware and container platform portfolio, including web servers, application servers, Kubernetes platforms, container images, and supporting infrastructure.
* Define and execute platform roadmaps aligned to cloud modernization and enterprise technology strategies.
* Ensure platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Drive technology currency through lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning of legacy technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience through self\-service capabilities, automation, and platform engineering practices.

### **Cloud \& Platform Engineering**

* Lead engineering and operational support for enterprise Kubernetes and AWS EKS platforms.
* Drive modernization initiatives, including migration of traditional middleware\-hosted applications to cloud\-native platforms.
* Establish standardized deployment patterns, container images, CI/CD pipelines, and operational practices.
* Manage Kubernetes cluster lifecycle activities including upgrades, capacity planning, security remediation, and platform observability.
* Partner with application teams to onboard workloads onto cloud platforms while ensuring operational readiness and supportability.

### **Middleware Services Management**

* Provide leadership for enterprise middleware technologies including: Apache HTTP Server Apache Tomcat Microsoft IIS IBM WebSphere Application Server Red Hat JBoss (preferred)
* Establish standards for platform configuration, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Ensure middleware environments remain secure, stable, and compliant with enterprise standards.

### **DevOps, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation initiatives using infrastructure and platform engineering tools.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support application and platform deployments.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management practices.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation, self\-healing capabilities, and reduction of manual processes.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, customer satisfaction, and cost optimization.

### **Service Reliability \& Operations**

* Ensure operational support for middleware and cloud platforms.
* Accountable for incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Lead major incident response, root cause analysis, and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Establish service\-level objectives (SLOs), operational metrics, and performance indicators.
* Drive improvements in platform availability, recovery capabilities, and operational maturity.

### **Security, Risk \& Compliance**

* Ensure platforms adhere to enterprise security, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Lead vulnerability remediation and security patching programs.
* Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls and tooling.
* Maintain audit readiness and governance for supported platforms.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

### **People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing engineering team.
* Drive organizational capability building through training, certification, and career development initiatives.
* Conduct performance management, talent reviews, hiring, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

### **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for middleware and cloud platform services.
* Build strong partnerships with application development, architecture, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams.
* Communicate platform health, risks, modernization initiatives, and strategic priorities to senior leadership.
* Manage vendor relationships and ensure delivery against service commitments and operational expectations.

### **Financial \& Capacity Management**

* Manage platform budgets, software licensing, and infrastructure consumption.
* Drive cloud and infrastructure cost optimization initiatives.
* Forecast platform growth and capacity requirements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of platform and infrastructure resources.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting enterprise middleware and infrastructure platforms.
* 4\+ years of leadership experience managing technology teams.
* Strong expertise in enterprise middleware technologies and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience leading large\-scale operational support and modernization initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

### **Container \& Cloud Platforms**

title: Product Portfolio Architect
description:
**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

Our organization is embarking on a massive digital transformation journey: the E\&C ALign Program. By 2027, we aim to deliver a globally integrated digital system for E\&C. A core component of this transformation includes migrating our engineering design suite from SmartPlant to AVEVA, alongside
  

the deployment of a new ERP system (Sap/4Hana) and a Project \& Portfolio Management (PPM) tool.We are seeking a Product Portfolio Architect to act as the Coordinator during the critical Design, Build \& Deployment phases of the E\&C ALign Program. This role ensures that the technical specifications provided to our System Integrators (SIs) are cohesive across our four domains (Project
  

Management, Engineering, Sales\&Technologies, and Manufacturing/OT) and that the resulting architecture is robust, scalable, and fully maintainable when handed over to the DDS InnoTech for "Run Mode." The Product Portfolio Architect will also be acting for the harmonization of the business applications within InnoTech perimeter, and the initiation of the related projects.
1\. Manage Cross\-Domain Digital Solutions roadmaps


Bridging the E\&C ALign program and the InnoTech Core Business Domains.


Ensure with the Integration and Architecture team the overall architecture compliance and coherency.


Contribute to review and harmonize specifications sent to the System Integrator, ensuring that integrations between the new AVEVA suite, the ERP, and existing tools create a seamless "Digital Thread”.


2\. Ensure the Maintainability \& Operational Readiness of the portfolio


Ensure that the integrated solutions being built in the Align Program are manageable, supportable, and cost\-effective for the Core Business Domains team post\-Go\-Live.Execute the handover strategy from the project phase to the operational phase, including support models (processes and SLAs definitions), licensing considerations, and internal IT upskilling.


Identify and mitigate technical debts or over\-customizations proposed by System Integrators or E\&C Business representatives that could complicate the “run” phase and/or future software upgrades.


3\. Secure DDS delivery to the Align Program


Manage Leadership \& Stakeholder Management


Work in a matrixed environment under the guidance of the E\&C ALign IT Project Manager and the E\&C ALign Design Authority to ensure project milestones are met on time and within scope. Collaborate with Business Process Owners (BPOs) and the Design Authority to ensure the technical


architecture actually supports the targeted "One E\&C Mindset" global processes, and that the business requirements are not exceeding the actual needs. title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.

title: Business Architect
description:
**Business Architect**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy working across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

As GCRS continues to expand across international markets and strengthen its technology, digital products and operational capabilities, we are seeking a **Business Architect** to help shape the way the organization operates and grows.

This position sits at the intersection of business strategy, operations and technology. The successful candidate will examine how different functions work together, identify opportunities for improvement and help create practical structures that support the company's long\-term objectives.

This role offers an opportunity to work on genuine business challenges, influence decision\-making and contribute to the development of processes and systems that can support GCRS as it scales.

**The Role**

The Business Architect will work with management and teams across regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product functions to understand business priorities and translate them into workable solutions.

You will examine existing processes, systems and operating models, challenge areas that are no longer effective and help design better ways of working.

Some projects may involve technology implementation or digital transformation, while others may focus on organisational structure, workflow design, process improvement or business planning. The ability to understand the wider business context while paying attention to operational details will be important.

This is a practical role for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems and can move confidently between strategic conversations and detailed process discussions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review existing business processes and workflows to understand what is working well and where teams may be facing unnecessary delays, duplication or inefficiencies.
* Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives and turn those objectives into clear, realistic and actionable requirements.
* Help develop business architecture frameworks and operating models that support the company's current needs while allowing room for future growth.
* Look for practical ways to improve productivity, reduce manual work and make business processes easier to manage and scale.
* Map key business functions, processes, capabilities and information flows to create a clear picture of how different areas of the organisation connect.
* Work with management to convert broader business strategies into structured initiatives, priorities and implementation plans.
* Identify gaps between the way a process works today and what the business will need in the future as GCRS expands.
* Prepare clear business requirements for software, digital transformation and technology\-related projects.
* Work closely with software developers, AI engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure that technology solutions address genuine business requirements.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of digital products and technology\-enabled services offered by GCRS.
* Assess existing processes and systems and recommend where technology could make operations more efficient or improve the client experience.
* Explore opportunities to introduce automation and AI where they can deliver meaningful improvements rather than adding unnecessary complexity.
* Create process maps, workflows, business models and functional requirements that can be easily understood by both business and technical teams.
* Understand how changes to one business function or system may affect other departments, processes, data or client\-facing activities.
* Support teams in designing and introducing new processes that are practical, clearly documented and easy for employees to adopt.
* Help GCRS build scalable operating structures that can support increasing clients, services, markets and internal teams.
* Review business performance and operational information to identify areas where processes, resources or systems could be improved.
* Prepare business cases, recommendations and supporting analysis for new projects, systems and strategic initiatives.
* Help management assess and prioritise business and technology projects based on their potential value, urgency, complexity and business impact.
* Bring relevant stakeholders together to clarify project objectives, define scope and ensure that expectations are aligned before implementation begins.
* Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams, helping both sides understand requirements, limitations and expected outcomes.
* Identify operational risks, process gaps and areas where the current way of working may create challenges as the business grows.
* Support the implementation of new processes and help teams adapt to changes in systems, technology and ways of working.
